I1.quote: Searched for a gravimetric (mass gain on H2 exposure), volumetric (Sieverts pressure-change) or flow uptake measurement and found none. The paper names a 'Sieverts-like hydrogenation setup' but reports no pressure-change, mass-gain or flow-consumption data. The stored amount is taken ex situ from the hydrogenated samples: 'The amount of hydrogen stored in the synthesized RGO, RGO/h-BN, RGO/A-HNT and RGO/A-HNT/h-BN hybrid nanocomposites is calculated from CHNS-elemental analysis' (main, p. 79078, Section 3.2); and the TGA desorption step: 'The initial weight loss of 3.3 wt% during 119-143 °C is attributed to desorption of stored hydrogen in hydrogenated nanocomposite' (main, p. 79078, Section 3.3).

I5.quote: The hydrogen storage performance of hybrid nanocomposites composed of reduced graphene oxide, acid treated halloysite nanotubes and hexagonal boron nitride nanoparticles (RGO/A-HNT/h-BN) was studied.
I5.location: main, p. 79072 (PDF p. 1), Abstract, first sentence

notes: Borderline on I1. Hydrogenation: 50 C, H2 flow 0.5 L/min for 15 min, chamber pressure 1 kg cm-2 (main, Section 2.7); the sample is then taken out and characterised. The reported H2 capacities (RGO 0.6, RGO/h-BN 1.8, RGO/A-HNT 2.2, RGO/A-HNT/h-BN 3.3 wt%; Fig. 10, Table 3) come from CHNS elemental analysis and from TGA mass loss on heating (Fig. 11), not from an in situ gravimetric, volumetric or flow uptake measurement. I read this as thermal-desorption type evidence without an uptake value of an eligible method, so I1 is not met and I2 to I4 are not assessed, which gives no_conditions_stated by the protocol rule. If a reader instead accepts the CHNS or TGA value as a gravimetric uptake value, I1, I2 (RGO and the RGO-dominated composites are carbon sorbents) and I3 (50 C, 1 kg cm-2) would be met, but I4 fails: a search of the main text and the SI (si1, Figs S1-S6) found no surface area, BET, pore or N2 adsorption measurement for any sample; the only mentions are generic statements about HNTs and h-BN in the Introduction. The code would then be no_surface_area. The paper is ineligible under either reading. Not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the PDF; the note after first publication concerns only a corrected corresponding author). Primary research article, not a review. No statement that the uptake values were published before.
